discrepancy_explanation: MDS converges extremely quickly (<20 iterations, <0.05s) due to the small training matrix size (~42x42) and eps=1e-4 tolerance. Total fold execution time is dominated by XGBoost (~0.4s) and OOS optimizations (~0.13s), taking roughly 1 second total per fold. Any large gaps in wall time between fold completions (e.g., minutes or hours) or out-of-order markers (like P0F0 completing after P1F2) are artifacts of the Phase 3 Resume Test and the --resume functionality, not long operation times.
